attributes.description: Identifies files written to disk whose SHA-256 hash matches a Slate Mortar espionage toolkit sample, as reported in campaign PTF-00892. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.
false_positives: Security testing that replays known indicators.
A shared hosting address or domain that later served benign content.
attributes.name: Slate Mortar Espionage Toolkit: File with known malicious hash written (PTF-00892)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Slate Mortar Espionage Toolkit: File with known malicious hash written

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Slate Mortar espionage toolkit in campaign PTF-00892.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
